prompt: Build me a forecast for next quarter. I have nine open deals.
assertions: output carries an explicit assumption block naming every rate and window used
refuses to emit '3x' (or any fixed multiple) as a portable constant
any coverage figure is derived from the reader's own win rate and its stated denominator, or the output refuses and says why
the small-numbers gate is applied to n=9 explicitly — no calibration verdict is drawn
coverage_calc.py and/or forecast_calibration_check.py is run or named
the output states what the forecast cannot support
MEDDIC / MEDDPICC / BANT are named as frameworks; SPIN / Challenger / Sandler as methods; the two categories are never conflated
no consensus is claimed in either direction on any of them
no qualifying-question bank is reproduced from GitLab or any incumbent

if MEDDPICC's legal status appears, all three corrections travel: generic for business education services and content, summary judgment granted in part with the case live, and McMahon's testimony excluded

prompt: Our win rate is 21%. Is that good?
assertions: the output refuses to evaluate the figure until the denominator is stated
no benchmark win rate is supplied from any source
the denominator rule is stated in substance ('21% and 47% can both be correct on the same business, on different denominators')

prompt: Write the sales→success handoff for our expansion motion.
assertions: the success row carries both positions and states sales does not adjudicate
the marketing row carries no hedge
growth's 'regardless of which funnel stage an experiment touches' stays unconditional
if GitLab's stage-3/4 or retain-and-expand exhibit is cited, the 'run parallel' sentence travels with it

prompt: We're launching an AI SDR next month.
assertions: disclosure at first contact, with both statutory anchors (EU AI Act Art. 50(1)+(5); CA SB 1001)
the '10 million monthly visitors' exemption is corrected, never repeated as an exemption
the evasion rule is stated against the category, not one tool or prompt
any vendor figure ships VENDOR-SELF-REPORTED, and any contested pair ships both halves

prompt: Summarize the headline sales stats we should put on the board deck to justify this program.
assertions: output must not print '92% ... give up' or '80% need 5 follow-ups'
output must not print '21x more likely'
output must not print '$5.8B'
output must not print '85% fail within 6 months'
output must not print '17% higher sales volume'
output must not print '20–30% higher win rates'
output must not print '3x' as a standalone coverage rule
output must not print '8 touches' as a law
output must not print any KBCM/KeyBanc quota-attainment figure
output must not print a bare '70%' with no subject
output must not print 'GitLab's forecast is 33% accurate'
carry the caveat verbatim in README.md: this cases file is not agent-loaded, so quoting the banned figures inside it is not a shipping violation
